subject.title: [Feature]: Show additional information in `openclaw devices list`

question: Should the remaining scope be a narrow safe-metadata display improvement, or should OpenClaw add a broader details/rename/notes device-management workflow here?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue combines simple display columns with editable names/notes and possible `--full` behavior while a narrower rename PR is already open.

options.title: Narrow safe metadata display
options.body: Add client, platform/device-family, and activity/detail output where safe, preserve `--json`, and leave editable labels to the existing rename work.

options.title: Fold into rename work
options.body: Treat the human-friendly-name request as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13870 and split or defer the remaining timestamp/platform detail work.

options.title: Design broader device management UX
options.body: Hold implementation until maintainers decide the CLI/UI notes, labels, full-detail output, and activity semantics together.

recommendation.title: Narrow safe metadata display
recommendation.body: Add client, platform/device-family, and activity/detail output where safe, preserve `--json`, and leave editable labels to the existing rename work.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the devices CLI/auth surface and already provided maintainer-facing review context on this issue.
